description: This file declares the StateTransitionHandler class responsible for managing state transition requests within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes singleton pattern implementation, initialization, termination, and request addition methods.

classes.name: StateTransitionHandler
classes.description: Handles state transition requests, implements singleton pattern, and manages lifecycle (initialization and termination).

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the StateTransitionHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the StateTransitionHandler, preparing it to handle requests.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the StateTransitionHandler, performing necessary cleanup.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a new StateTransitionRequest to the handler.

methods.name: StateTransitionHandler (constructor)
methods.description: Private constructor to enforce singleton pattern.

methods.name: ~StateTransitionHandler (destructor)
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup upon deletion of singleton instance.
